text.p: Gasgoyne Gold Mines NL said on Monday a meeting would be convened soon to consider a selective reduction of capital under which those shares not held by Sons of Gwalia Ltd and Coeur d'Alene Mines Corp would be extinquished after a cash payment of A$4.25 per share.
"The minorities whose shares will be cancelled under the proposed selective reduction of capital, held 1,626,340 shares equivalent to 2.8 per cent of the company," Gasgoyne said.
Gasgoyne's independent directors said that an independent report as to whether the proposal was fair and reasonable to the minority shareholders would be commissioned.
Sons of Gwalia Ltd, which holds 35.8 million or 62 percent of Gasgoyne and Coeur d'Alene Mines, which holds 20.3 million or 35 percent of Gasgoyne, would not vote on the resolution to cancel shares.
Gasgoyne's shares were up 15 cents at A$3.00 before a trading halt earlier on Monday.
